create.name: A.Me.Co. – Associazione per la Meditazione di Consapevolezza
create.bio:
A.Me.Co., the Association for Mindfulness Meditation, is a Theravada Buddhist association in Rome, a short walk from St Peter's, devoted to vipassanā or insight meditation. It was founded in December 1987 by the scholar and meditation teacher Corrado Pensa, Neva Papachristou and six other practitioners. Pensa, who taught Indian religions and philosophy at Rome's Sapienza University and was a senior teacher at the Insight Meditation Society in Massachusetts, guided it with Papachristou until his death in 2024. Papachristou, who has practised since 1984 and was authorised to teach by Larry Rosenberg of the Cambridge Insight Meditation Center, is now its guiding teacher; together the two wrote several Italian books on mindfulness practice.

The programme is open to members, who join for a modest yearly fee. Evening seminar series in Rome, which can also be followed live on Zoom, combine meditation instruction, guided sittings, talks on the Dharma and time for questions, with particular care taken over newcomers. Visiting teachers from the Western insight tradition give online intensives, and Papachristou leads residential retreats elsewhere in Italy. Members receive recordings of the sessions, the association's magazine SATI and use of its library, while many evening talks and guided meditations are shared on its YouTube channel.

courses.title: Come la pratica ci insegna a invecchiare meglio a tutte le età
courses.description: A two-evening Dharma and vipassanā seminar with Neva Papachristou on how practice helps us grow older well at any age; the first evening is in Rome and on Zoom, the second on Zoom only. Open to members of the association.
courses.price: 15 euro in presenza e di 10 euro su Zoom

courses.title: Ritiro di Dharma e meditazione vipassanā a Pomaia
courses.description: A residential Dharma and insight meditation retreat led by Neva Papachristou and hosted by the Istituto Lama Tzong Khapa at Pomaia, near Pisa. Open to all; bookings are taken by the host institute.
